prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. GLAZE ANAGLYPH CROSSING, a tangible migration of invented fauna rendered in a clean optical stereoscopic image language. MEDIUM: RED/CYAN DUAL-REGISTRATION ANAGLYPH-STYLE EXPOSURE. Two slightly different binocular projections of ONE coherent creature overlap into a single image. The left-view signal is clear vermilion red, the right-view signal is bright process cyan; shared structure becomes charcoal-blue with pale neutral white volumes. Red and cyan outer contours are visibly displaced by a few percent of the subject width, with different parallax around near and far limbs. The doubled contours and internal joint edges must be unmistakable even at thumbnail size. Clean continuous neutral tone fields, crisp bold silhouette, broad simple forms. This is an artistic optical registration image, not a calibrated stereo pair. Not two separate creatures or side-by-side panels. No paper texture, ink grain, screenprint hatching, lines filling the whole form, diffraction bands, rainbow, thermal heat gradients, glowing scan points, X-ray skeleton, physical sculpture, shiny plastic, clay, glass or chrome. No words, labels, numerals, coordinates, clock faces, readings, graphs, logos or watermark. Asset: ONE separate square 1024x1024 pure-art widget. A small curved rear balancing tail completes the silhouette. Three-quarter stepping pose, friendly curious anatomy with clear head/arms/joints/feet. Head is a living shield structure, not a mask, robot helmet or human face. The complete animal AND BOTH colour-displaced registrations must remain inside central 75% of canvas; very generous empty margins. True transparent alpha exterior and open gaps; no white rectangular backing, ground, shadow, exterior haze, frame, tile, panel, diagram or device mockup.
